_comment: The guided tours of the website, written by hand. scripts/site-data.mjs turns each step into a canvas tour step: `card` names the card by its label on the endpoint's flow, `lines` names the lines to light by text they contain. The file and line numbers come from the index, so an edit to the demo cannot leave a step pointing at the wrong place (the script fails instead).

steps.title: The request comes in
steps.caption: POST /orders lands in the controller, which passes the order straight to the service. Nothing is checked on the way in.

steps.title: Three things, in this order
steps.caption: The service saves the order, asks billing for an invoice, then announces the order. Each call is a card to the right.

steps.title: What gets stored
steps.caption: The save writes the `orders` table. The columns are read from the entity, so you see what is stored without opening `Order.java`.

steps.title: Out to another service
steps.caption: Billing is a separate service, written in Python. This is an HTTP POST to `/api/invoices`, and the flow follows it there.

steps.title: Where the POST arrives
steps.caption: The billing route that call reaches. The link was matched by its path, so the canvas draws it dashed: a guess, not a certainty.

steps.title: The invoice
steps.caption: Billing stores the invoice, then hands the receipt to a background task.

steps.title: Back in orders
steps.caption: The order goes out on the Kafka topic `order.placed`. Anyone listening on it is part of this flow too.

steps.title: Shipping hears about it
steps.caption: The shipping service listens on that topic and schedules a shipment. One request: three services and three tables.

steps.title: A Java endpoint
steps.caption: The orders service has a route for an order's invoice, but it does not keep invoices itself.

steps.title: It asks billing
steps.caption: It asks the billing service over HTTP, with the order id in the path.

steps.title: Into Python
steps.caption: The flow continues in the billing service, in another language. The dashed edge says the route was matched by path.

steps.title: The query
steps.caption: Billing looks the invoice up by order id.

steps.title: The table it reads
steps.caption: The `invoices` table, read from billing's own models. Two services and two languages, on one canvas.
